evidence: JobDisposition::Retry path drops the job silently when serde_json::to_string(&job) OR redis.queue_push fails — only a tracing::warn! "job dropped" fires; no durable backing, no deadletter, no retry-on-publish. Reintroduces the exact silent-loss failure mode the retry mechanism was added to close: a Redis blip (NOAUTH/LOADING/connection reset) during requeue permanently loses the push that just failed its first delivery attempt. The comment at :274 ("job dropped") acknowledges the window with no mitigation path.

signals.source: Phase 1.5 rotating expert review 2026-11-21 api-core (churn-aligned; rust)
evidence: send_fcm_v1: `match resp.json::<FcmSendResponse>().await` treats `Err(parse_error)` as (false,false) regardless of captured status. A 2xx FCM response with an unexpected body shape therefore returns success=false → ProviderOutcome::Failed(PushFailed) → is_transient_push_error → Retry, requeuing a message FCM already accepted. Hidden duplicate-delivery window on parse edge cases (field renames, proxy rewrites, truncated reads).
